entities.summary: Paul Louis Adrien Henri Hymans, was a Belgian politician associated with the Liberal Party. He was the second president of the League of Nations and served again as its president in 1932–1933. Paul Hymans was a political leaders from Ixelles (1865-03-23, Ixelles–1941-03-08).
